description: A Next.js folder convention that intercepts client-side navigations to another URL path and renders an alternate UI (such as a modal) within the current layout.
Intercepting prefixes like (.) and (..) count URL route segments rather than physical folders, ignoring @slot and (group) directories completely.
The standard page.tsx route (e.g. app/photo/[id]/page.tsx) that renders a standalone page whenever a user visits the URL directly or refreshes the browser.
Closing a URL-driven modal with router.back() when in-app history exists so the browser history stack unwinds cleanly back to the underlying page.
